Subject: Private Offer: term & buyer approval path for NovusHealth

Hi Angela,

Thanks again for the product chat this morning — appreciate the detailed use case and the emphasis on latency and data isolation for the pilot. As we discussed, we can put a private offer in AWS Marketplace that aligns to your preferred term length and buyer approval path. To prepare the Private Offer we'll need two quick things from your side: a) preferred term length (12 / 24 / 36 months) and b) a short list of the approvers that need to sign (procurement, legal, finance, CIO, etc.).

High-level notes so you have context while you confirm:
- We can offer a stepped discount with longer commitments (example in follow-up).
- Activation on AWS Marketplace requires buyer acceptance of the Private Offer and can take 24–48 hours once docs are signed.
- We can accommodate standard enterprise payment terms but need to know whether Novus prefers PO-based billing or DocuSign signature + invoice.

I’ve looped in Ben (pricing) and Sofia (onboarding/activation). If it helps, Ben can send a compact term worksheet with price bands; I can attach our evidence pack for SOC 2 / data handling.

Quick next steps: if you can reply with the approver list and preferred term window by EOD Wednesday (or tell us a good time for procurement sync), Ben and I will prepare a Private Offer draft and an evidence pack.

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole

Marissa,

Thanks — great to meet the team earlier. Two quick clarifications from procurement + finance:

1) Evidence pack: please send SOC 2, data retention, and encryption evidence. Procurement will need that for the approval packet.
2) Term length: our initial preference is 24 months, but finance asked whether there is a material discount differential for 36 months vs 24 months.
3) Approvers: procurement (me), legal (Sam Rivera), finance (CFO: Priya Desai), and our VP of Engineering (Raj Patel) are typically on the approval path.
4) Payment terms: Novus prefers PO -> 30 net, but we can consider alternative billing if Redwood needs shorter payment windows.

Also: does Redwood accept AWS Marketplace billing (invoice via AWS) or do you prefer direct billing? That will affect our procurement checklist.

Can you send the evidence pack + a compact term/price worksheet? If you can get that to me by tomorrow, procurement will triage for an initial internal review next week.

Best,
Angela

Marissa / Sofia —

Drafting the compact term sheet for Novus. Based on comparable pilots and the feature set they need (dedicated capacity + private VPC option), here are sensible, clean options we can present:

Option A — 12 months (pilot-to-commit)
- List price: $X/month
- Intro discount: 5%
- Activation: standard
- Good if they want short runway before committing long-term

Option B — 24 months (recommended)
- List price: $X/month
- Discount: 12%
- Preferred for pilot -> production ramp; lower unit price

Option C — 36 months (max discount)
- List price: $X/month
- Discount: 18%
- We can include a mid-term price review at month 18; requires CFO ok

Notes and asks:
- We can accept PO -> Net30 invoicing via AWS Marketplace (they can route invoices through AWS), but if Novus needs Redwood invoiced directly we should confirm procurement/legal acceptance.
- For Marketplace Private Offers, buyer signature on the Private Offer is the gating event; once signed, AWS activates the entitlement.
- Attachments I’m preparing: Private_Offer_Term_Summary.xlsx (pricing bands + activation notes) and Novus_Evidence_Pack.pdf (SOC 2/retention/encryption).

Suggested internal approach: present Option B and option C (if CFO wants longer-term) and ask to confirm approver list and whether they will send a PO or sign via DocuSign. If they want PO flow we need the exact remittance and billing contact to include on the Private Offer.

I’ll attach the worksheet and evidence pack to the next outbound.

Ben Carter
Principal Sales, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Hi Angela —

Thanks for the rapid turn. Attached are the two docs Ben referenced: the evidence pack and a compact term worksheet with the three options and the expected activation steps.

Attachments included:
- Novus_Evidence_Pack.pdf (SOC 2 summary, data retention and encryption notes, sample audit log extract)
- Private_Offer_Term_Summary.xlsx (simple table: 12/24/36 mo pricing bands, discount %, activation notes)

Quick summary for procurement: we recommend presenting Option B (24 months) to Finance as the balanced path. If Novus prefers a 36-month structure we can increase the discount but will add a mid-term price review.

We can do either:
- PO path: Novus submits a PO; we will convert into a Private Offer and coordinate activation with AWS once PO and approver list are received.
- DocuSign path: complete the DocuSign signature on the Private Offer (link below) and AWS will activate the entitlement once accepted.

DocuSign (option, if you prefer signing): https://www.docusign.net/Member/PowerFormSigning.aspx?PowerFormId=abcd-1234
HubSpot record for reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Action items:
1) Can you confirm the approver list (names and emails) we should include on the Private Offer?
2) Which billing flow do you prefer: PO -> Net30 via AWS or DocuSign signature + invoice?
3) If PO, please send the remittance/billing contact and the PO number when available.

If you’d like to go through the worksheet together, we can carve 30 minutes tomorrow morning to walk the Finance/CFO through the numbers.

Best,
